description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of 'git archive' and related commands within the Git project. It includes setup procedures, test definitions, and validation functions for different scenarios such as tar extraction, commit id embedding, handling large files, and various formats.

methods.name: get_pax_header
methods.description: Function to read and extract pax headers from a tar file to verify embedded metadata.

methods.name: check_tar
methods.description: Function to extract a tar archive and validate its contents and headers.

methods.name: check_added
methods.description: Function to validate that a file has been correctly added or copied from the archive.

methods.name: check_mtime
methods.description: Function to verify the modification time of a file inside the archive matches expected value.

methods.name: tar_info
methods.description: Function to parse tar file listing output to extract size and year information for testing large and future dates.
